arguments: Multipart cipher update uses caller-controlled vectors without validation
message.text: Multipart cipher update uses caller-controlled vectors without validation

properties.metisTriageReason: Verdict: Inconclusive; the update block forwards vector fields to psa_cipher_update, but the partition-boundary vector source is an initialization wrapper whose mapping guarantees are unresolved. Evidence: crypto_cipher.c reads in_vec[1] and out_vec[0] then calls psa_cipher_update at secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_cipher.c:272, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_cipher.c:274, and secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_cipher.c:277, while crypto_init.c initializes vectors before dispatch via mapping or scratch-buffer paths at secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:69, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:73, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:82, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:165, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:168, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:177, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:188, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:291, and secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:299. Gap: psa_map_invec/psa_map_outvec behavior and the active PSA_FRAMEWORK_HAS_MM_IOVEC branch are not resolved by the provided evidence.
properties.mitigation: Validate vector bases and lengths for TFM_CRYPTO_CIPHER_UPDATE_SID before operation lookup or before calling psa_cipher_update. Consider helper functions that enforce the vector contract for each SID and ensure zero-length buffers are handled consistently with PSA requirements.
properties.reasoning: After looking up a multipart operation, the update path forwards input and output vector pointers and lengths directly to psa_cipher_update. Unlike the handle-related paths, there is no local check that in_vec[1].base and out_vec[0].base are valid for the advertised lengths. A malformed update request at the partition boundary could therefore cause the backend to read or write through invalid pointers, potentially faulting the secure service and causing denial of service. Additional dispatcher-side vector validation may reduce or eliminate exploitability, but the assumptions are not visible in this file.
